_about: Standalone A1+A2+A3 (9-class) MLLM-free face real/fake ensemble. Paths are relative to this file.
fusion: mean (per-model Platt calibration fit to identity on the tuning set)
threshold_note: 0.5343 = in-sample optimum on the full heldout3/frames test (max PAD-recall s.t. real-recall>=85%): real 85.0 / PAD 98.7. 0.6337 = source-disjoint-tuned default (more conservative; real 88.1 / PAD 98.1 on the same full set). Use 0.6337 for robust deployment on new data.
texts: misaligned features, smooth skin, inconsistent lighting, blending artifacts, unnatural integration between the face and body/the face and the background
flat depth, uniform lighting, screen smoothing, moire patterns, screen borders, UI, reflections, glossy/plastic skin, rigid edges, hand-holding signs, recapture blur
consistent facial features, natural skin texture, consistent lighting, normal facial 3D depth, the absence of clear manipulation or visible artifacts
label_scheme: 9-class: label = 3*true + claim ; true/claim in {0:real, 1:pad, 2:deepfake} ; pad includes makeup
eval_note: Numbers above are recall (%) on a 30K video/identity-disjoint held-out set (frame-based, full-image, MLLM-free).
